verbatim_snippet: "I have been using Patreon and I can confidently say that their customer support is non-existent. Over this long period, I have reached out multiple times for various issues, and not once have I received actual help. They simply do not care about their creators or users. It is frustrating to invest time and money into a platform that ignores you when things go wrong. If you are looking for a service that values its community and provides basic assistance, look elsewhere. Patreon is great at taking their cut, but terrible at providing any value in return. Extremely disappointed."
